semantics.note: Preserves the deployment forecast and construction assumption. The construction rate supplies the forecast's basis; it does not impose an additional requirement that the rate remain unchanged.

contract.note: Aggregate deployment into useful operation is a fair ordinary reading. The contract appropriately preserves fiscal/calendar ambiguity and does not treat one operating cluster as decisive.

evidence.note: The dated technical report establishes an operating cluster and satisfies the limited construction antecedent. It does not establish representative deployment timing for the relevant sales cohort.
NVIDIA's company disclosure reports consolidated fiscal-year revenue. It does not isolate calendar-year GPU sales or connect purchases to operational deployment.

reviews.rationale: The 2028–2029 horizon remains future. The operating cluster satisfies the limited construction condition but does not meet the representative-deployment early-resolution rule. Neither item establishes aggregate commissioning timing or the claimed advance purchases.

attribution.note: Zitron makes and endorses the statement himself.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the present-tense observation and its qualifying word, 'appears'.

contract.note: The contract converts a hedged impression into a scored universal assertion. The plain-reading exception applies only to firm language. The specific quarter and net-profit convention also come from the evaluator.

evidence.note: The company transcript reports a quarterly consolidated loss. It does not isolate AI-rental profit or establish profitability across the provider universe.
The company disclosure explains adjusted measures and their exclusions. Positive adjusted EBITDA cannot establish net profit attributable to AI rentals.

reviews.rationale: The qualifier 'appears' makes this a hedged assessment, which the policy excludes from scoring. A plain-reading contract cannot remove that qualification. The company disclosures also do not establish comprehensive activity-level profitability.
